subject: Aids to Navigation - Dixon Entrance West
text:
Aids to Navigation - Dixon Entrance West
Changes have been made to the Mackie Rock port bifurcation daybeacon in the vicinity of 53 41.650N 132 19.358W
New characteristics are Fl (3) W12s, 6nm nominal range and a radar reflector has been added.
    Aids: 
                Mackie Rock port daybeacon
